name: IACT 2 Computers Education
description: Demo website for IACT 2 Computers Education, a computer training institute in Phuldungri, Ghatshila, Jharkhand. Showcases courses (DCA, ADCA, Tally Prime + GST, MS Office, Web Designing, Programming, DTP, CCC, Data Entry), about, gallery, student reviews, an admission enquiry form that sends via WhatsApp, and a contact/location section with Google Maps.
